description: Source code for the bbram driver for the IT8XXX2 chip in the Zephyr RTOS, implementing read, write, get_size, and initialization functions with configuration and magic number validation.

methods.name: bbram_it8xxx2_read
methods.description: Reads data from the BBRAM device at a specified offset and size.

methods.name: bbram_it8xxx2_write
methods.description: Writes data to the BBRAM device at a specified offset and size.

methods.name: bbram_it8xxx2_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the BBRAM device.

methods.name: bbram_it8xxx2_init
methods.description: Initializes the BBRAM device, checking and setting magic flags.
